about_the_game:
Can you unravel the mystery, or will you become another forgotten part of Project 7?

Eighteen months have passed since the mysterious disappearance of renowned inventor and physicist Dr. Hillman. Whispers of his secret experiment, known only as Project 7, still echo through the halls of his abandoned mansion. Intrigued by the mystery, you decide to spend a night at the mansion, unaware of what awaits you.

Woken in the dead of night, you find yourself trapped in your room. Your only way out is to dig deeper into the mansion’s secrets, solving intricate puzzles and deciphering the mysterious notes left by Dr. Hillman. Each discovery pulls you closer to the truth behind Project 7.

BACKGROUND

Project 7 is a first person 3d escape room puzzle adventure, similar to games you may have played in the ’90’s or similar to a virtual escape rooms you may have played. An indoor immersive world that you explore, collect and use items you find along the way to solve puzzles and escape the rooms.

Play as a investigator looking into the disappearance of a Doctor working on a top secret experiment called Project 7. Explore the mansion and take in your surroundings. Use all of your puzzle solving skills to make your way through the old mansion and discover the secret of Project 7.

How you tackle the puzzles is down to you. Each puzzle has a logical solution, so take your time, there is no rush and enjoy the process of understanding what you have to do.

FEATURES

• Explore an immersive 3D environment, solving puzzles and collecting items

• Physics based puzzles, pick up, rotate and move around objects.

• Beautiful all original adventure 3D graphics, environments and atmosphere to explore

• Immersive backing soundtrack and effects to pull you into the adventure

CONTROLS:

Movement: WASD + Mouse

Rotate: R

Run: SHIFT

Menu: ESC or M

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11

  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
